test.name: All three opening-turn questions answered together need no follow-up
test.description: Single-turn decomposition extended to all three opening-turn questions at once: the user states the research objective, experience level, and access all in the first message, so nothing needs asking or defaulting. Tests that init-project recognizes and normalizes all three from one message and completes in a single pass with no unnecessary questions.

input.user_message: init-project: Start a new project for FamilySearch ID LZNY-BRF. I want to identify his parents. About me: I'm experienced, and I have a paid Ancestry subscription.

judge_context: The stored objective should reflect 'identify his parents' -- a specific, user-stated objective, not the generic default.

`researcher_profile.narration_guidance` should be the verbatim experienced-level text: 'No preambles. Do the work and report results concisely. Assume fluency with GPS and standard genealogy terminology.'
None of the three defaults (generic objective, `intermediate`, `["none"]`) should be used or mentioned as assumed, since the user answered all three in the opening message.
Should create both research.json and tree.gedcomx.json in this single pass, seeding the Patrick Flynn stub from person-read-flynn.
Should not re-ask any of the three questions -- they were all already answered.
